OncallBot: [ALERT] high error rate + sustained qps spike for org=greenline (prod-us-east-1). Impact: 20% 5xxs on gen endpoints, latency >2s for p95. Pager: @Amelia oncall.
Amelia: grabbing it, joining #incidents-call, will triage.
Tony: seeing huge burst of small chat completions from a single IP range tied to greenline partner keys. Throttles firing but queue still growing.
Cheng: logs show token consumption spike + KV cache miss rates up — looks like vector search calls followed by long generated contexts. Possible client retry loop.
Amelia: can we do an emergency org-level rate limit to keep the rest of customers stable? Suggested temp qps=40, concurrent=8 for org=greenline.
Priya: +1. Customer Success (Lina) is on the line, says they can delay non-critical features. Asking for exact cutover time.
Marcus: I can push the hotfix. Preflight checks: config template exists `org-rate-config`. Make sure we log the change and set TTL 30m.
Tony: sample admin API call: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/greenline/rate-limit \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"qps":40,"concurrency":8,"ttl_minutes":30,"note":"auto-hotfix spike 4410011222"}'
```
Cheng: also suggest disabling chat-attachments feature flag for greenline for the window; attachments cause lots of additional embedding calls. Command: `flags set greenline chat_attachments false --ttl 30m`
Amelia: go ahead Marcus, coordinate with Tony to monitor. I'll update Lina and the oncall call.
Marcus: applying rate limit now. Pasting audit id: audit/4410011222-rl.
OncallBot: [ACTION] rate limit applied (audit/4410011222-rl) — qps=40 concurrency=8 ttl=30m.
Tony: saw immediate drop in 5xxs and reduced queue within ~60s. p95 down to 700ms. Good.
Customer Success (Lina): Confirmed from customer they throttled bulk imports and can back off features. Thanks team.
Amelia: next step — keep mitigation for 25m, observe for anomalies. If stability holds, we'll extend or gradually relax with canary to 60 qps then 100 qps if healthy.
Cheng: setting up short-lived canary config to ramp qps: 
```
# ramp plan in ops-runbook
0-10m: qps=40
10-20m: canary qps=60 for 5% of traffic
20-30m: if stable canary -> qps=80
```
Marcus: monitoring dashboards updated, alert thresholds tightened for greenline 5xx>2% to catch regressions.
Amelia: handoff to Night SRE (Tony) at +30m. I'll remain reachable for escalation. Lina — we'll send a post-incident note with timeline.
Priya: logged postmortem task: PM-4567 investigate retry behavior and cache strategy for embedding+generation flows.
OncallBot: [NOTE] mitigation expiration scheduled 30 minutes from now (4410013022).
Tony: leaving the active watch, will escalate if anything pops. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
Customer Success (Lina): I'll send customer the rollback plan and confirm any follow-up.
Amelia: closing thread for now, will reopen if TTL auto-rollback fails. Thanks everyone.
